items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: that's when I first heard Stravinsky's work, "The Firebird Suite" and "Rite of Spring."

ctx.x: Bumps was a fine saxophone player. And we used to meet there... And that's when I first heard Stravinsky's work, "The Firebird Suite" and "Rite of Spring." Max Roach took me around to the hotel. He says, "Look, I want you to hear some things. I want you to hear something." So he took me around to the hotel and put these records on. And that was my first hearing, you know; and that was really exciting.
